title: ISS securities: engines/stock/markets/index
description: The only market with more than one enabled board today: IMOEX/IMOEX2/RGBI trade on SNDX, RTSI on RTSI. A listing born from this market therefore carries no single board, and its catalog key omits the venue block entirely (MISX:<ticker>, not MISX:<board>:<ticker>) — see catalog_model.Listing.key and the v9->v10 migration notes in catalog_schema.py.
